## Model Comparison

| Model | MAE | RMSE | SMAPE | R² |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Gradient Boosting | 67.27 | 214.09 | 65.66% | 0.9704 |
| Tuned XGBoost | 72.24 | 235.40 | 68.81% | 0.9642 |

Gradient Boosting was selected as the final production model
because it achieved the lowest MAE and RMSE and the highest R²
on the held-out test set.
